items.text:
upd: may 2026
DEVS! JUST A HOPE OF MULTIPLAYER BEING A THING, AND MY SOUL IS YOURS!

some say the game is not friendly to newbies... They are wrong.
After Stationeers, Barotrauma and Rimworld- Ostranauts is a breeze to get into. The new tutorial is a little janky, but it works- The open-ended gameplay loop is amazing, and while ship-building leaves much to be desired, it's still an incredibly solid experience.
Don't feel like playing as a space scavenger? Play a merc, run gigs, get paid. Become a pirate, steal stuff. That's too much action for you? Become the friend of the world, and chat your way up to being the famous chatterbox of K-leg. 

All in all- A finished game, with hours of content. All that's missing is a multiplayer mode... But in reality- It's amazing nonetheless, even as a solo experience. Maybe a little polish around the rough edges- Overall, 10/10, would recommend.
items.text_zh:
更新：2026年5月
开发者们！只要有一丝多人模式能成真的希望，我的灵魂就是你们的！

有人说这游戏对新手不友好……他们错了。
在玩过《Stationeers》、《Barotrauma》和《Rimworld》之后——Ostranauts上手简直轻而易举。新的教程有点蹩脚，但能用——开放式的玩法循环非常棒，虽然造船方面还有很多不足之处，但它仍然是一款极其扎实的游戏体验。
不想扮演太空拾荒者？那就当个雇佣兵，接任务，拿报酬。当个海盗，偷东西。这对你来说动作太多了？那就成为世界的朋友，一路聊到成为K-leg著名的碎嘴子。

总而言之——一款完整的游戏，有数小时的游戏内容。唯一缺的就是多人模式……但实际上——即便如此，作为单人体验，它依然非常出色。也许粗糙的边缘还需要一点打磨——总体而言，10/10，会推荐。
